thought.title: Fused-input softmax with DataCopyPad for CANN 8.5.0
thought.description: Pre-fuse qk+bias+mask on Python side into single input with -inf for masked positions. Single VECIN/VECOUT AscendC kernel computes softmax via fp32 TBuf: Cast fp16→fp32, scalar max-find, Adds(-max), Exp, scalar sum, Muls(1/sum), Cast fp32→fp16. Uses DataCopyPad for GM↔UB transfers.
thought.reason: Multi-VECIN-queue fails CANN 8.5.0 TQue depth assertion. Pre-fusion enables single-queue design. DataCopyPad required for correct GM↔UB transfer.
thought.target_bottleneck: Scalar loops on TBuf limit throughput; single-row processing with no vectorization
